tasks.title: Status button not updating from text entered after session close
tasks.description: When a session is closed, any status text entered in the status input field is not being reflected in the UI. The status button should update to show the new text immediately when it's submitted, regardless of whether the session is still active. Investigation needed to determine if this is a client-side state sync issue, a WebSocket connection drop, or a server-side persistence problem.

tasks.plan:
See Obsidian Task-38-wire-runtime-validation-use-compiled-contracts.md for full plan.

## Overview

Wire the compiled Zod contracts from task #37 into server.js. Three changes: (1) add dedicated tsc build step compiling src/contracts/ to compiled/contracts/, (2) replace VALID_BACKLOG_STATUSES Set and _validImpact() with BacklogStatus.safeParse() and ImpactEnum.safeParse(), (3) add WS_SCHEMA_REGISTRY + validation gate in handleMessage() rejecting known-type messages with missing required fields.

## Phases

### Phase A — Compilation Infrastructure
1. Create tsconfig.contracts.json (rootDir: ./src, outDir: ./compiled, includes only src/contracts/**/*)
2. Add ImpactEnum named export to src/contracts/backlog.ts
3. Add build:contracts and prestart scripts to package.json
4. Run npm run build:contracts — verify compiled/contracts/*.js files exist
5. git add compiled/ to commit compiled output

### Phase B — Backlog Validation Replacement
1. Add require(./compiled/contracts/backlog) at top of server.js
2. Replace _validImpact() body with ImpactEnum.safeParse()-backed check (same signature)
3. Replace VALID_BACKLOG_STATUSES.has(newStatus) with BacklogStatus.safeParse(newStatus).success
4. Delete VALID_BACKLOG_STATUSES const block

### Phase C — WS Receive-Side Validation
1. Add require(./compiled/contracts/ws-messages) at top of server.js
2. Add WS_SCHEMA_REGISTRY Map (type string -> Zod schema) covering all ~75 client->server message types from AnyClientMessage
3. In handleMessage(), after JSON.parse, add validation gate: unknown types pass through, known types with wrong fields return { type: error, code: INVALID_MSG, msgType, issues }

### Phase D — Final Compile + Commit
1. npm run build:contracts — final compile picks up ImpactEnum
2. Bump package.json version (patch)
3. git add + commit + push

objective.statement: Replace all hand-rolled validation in server.js with compiled Zod validators from src/contracts/, and add WS receive-side schema enforcement so malformed client messages are rejected with a structured error before reaching dispatch handlers.

tasks.title: Auto-purge stale session worktrees
tasks.description: Polaris creates a git worktree under %TEMP%\polaris-wt\ for every chat session but never cleans them up. Over time these accumulate (60+ directories observed). Add a startup sweep (and optionally a periodic timer) that removes worktrees older than 7 days: (1) list all registered worktrees via git worktree list --porcelain, (2) skip the main worktree and any branch-named worktrees (task/* or wip/*), (3) for detached-HEAD worktrees whose directory mtime is older than the threshold, run git worktree remove --force, (4) log each removal to the existing Polaris health/log channel. Threshold should be a constant (DEFAULT_WORKTREE_TTL_DAYS = 7) near the top of server.js. The sweep must never remove a worktree whose session is still open (check against active sessionStore entries by matching the worktree path).
